description: This file defines the QrSegment class for encoding segments of data in QR codes, including static factory methods for creating segments in various modes, and internal logic for handling different encoding modes and character sets.

classes.name: QrSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of data to be encoded in a QR code, supporting multiple encoding modes and providing factory methods for segment creation.

classes.name: QrSegment.Mode
classes.description: Enumeration of QR code data encoding modes, with methods to determine character count bit length based on QR version.

methods.name: makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from binary data in byte mode.

methods.name: makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: makeSegments
methods.description: Creates a list of segments from any Unicode string, choosing encoding modes automatically.

methods.name: makeEci
methods.description: Creates a segment representing an Extended Channel Interpretation (ECI) designator.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns a copy of the data bits of the segment.
